name: Alert
description: You gain the following benefits: Initiative Proficiency. You add your Proficiency Bonus to your Initiative rolls. Initiative Swap. Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally within 30 feet of yourself. You can't use this benefit if you have the Incapacitated condition.

name: Crafter
description: You gain the following benefits: Crafting Flexibility. You gain Tool Proficiency in one set of Artisan's Tools of your choice. You can create items using that set of tools even if the recipe requires other Artisan's Tools. Tool Expertise. Choose one set of Artisan's Tools in which you have Proficiency. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any check you make with that set of tools.

name: Healer
description: You gain the following benefits: Battle Medic. When you use a Healer's Kit to stabilize a creature that has 0 Hit Points, that creature also regains 1 Hit Point. Healing Rerolls. Whenever you roll a die to determine the number of Hit Points you restore with a spell or with this feat's Heroic Healer benefit, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll. Heroic Healer. As a Magic action, you can expend one use of a Healer's Kit to tend to a creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

name: Lucky
description: You gain the following benefits: Luck Points. You have Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can expend Luck Points to gain Advantage on attack rolls, Ability Checks, or saving throws. You can also cause Attacking to have Disadvantage. Reroll 1s. When you roll a 1 on a d20 for an attack roll, Ability Check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die. You can choose to do this before or after making the roll.

name: Magic Initiate
description: You gain the following benefits: Cantrip. Choose a class with a Spell List: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard. Choose two cantrips from that list. Spell. Learn one level 1 spell from the same list. Using the Spell. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting Ability for the spells you cast with this feat (choose when you select the feat).

name: Musician
description: You gain the following benefits: Inspiring Song. As a Magic action, you can play a Tiny instrument and give yourself and one ally within 5 feet of yourself a Heroic Inspiration. The ally must be able to hear you. Number of Uses. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

name: Savage Attacker
description: You gain the following benefits: Savage Attack. Once per turn, you can reroll a damage die used in a weapon attack. You must use the new roll. Heavy Weapon Training. You gain Proficiency with the following weapons: Battleaxe, Flail, Greataxe, Greatsword, Halberd, Lance, Longsword, Maul, Morningstar, Pike, Rapier, Scimitar, Shortsword, Trident, War Pick, Warhammer, Whip.

name: Skilled
description: You gain the following benefits: Skill Proficiencies. You gain Proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools of your choice.

name: Tavern Brawler
description: You gain the following benefits: Tavern Brawler. You gain Proficiency with Improvised Weapons and with your choice of one of the following weapons: Club, Handaxe, Quarterstaff, or Unarmed Strike. Pugilist. Your Unarmed Strike deals 1d6 Bludgeoning damage instead of the usual 1.

name: Tough
description: You gain the following benefits: Tough Constitution. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 2 times your character level. Whenever you gain a character level, your Hit Point maximum increases by an additional 2 Hit Points. Diehard. You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws.

name: Ability Score Improvement
description: You gain the following benefits: Increase the score of one Ability by 2, or increase the score of two Abilities by 1. Neither of these increases can raise an Ability Score above 20. If this feat is your starting feat, you can't increase an Ability Score above 20. At certain character levels, you can select this feat to increase your Ability Scores further. See the Character Advancement table in the Player's Handbook for more information.

name: Actor
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Bardic Inspiration. You can use a Bonus Action to give one creature within 60 feet of yourself a Bardic Inspiration die (a d6). A creature can use the die after witnessing a performance by you. Deception and Performance Proficiency. You gain Proficiency with Deception and Performance. If you're already Proficient, you instead double your Proficiency Bonus for any check you make with Deception or Performance.

name: Athlete
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Climb Speed. You gain a Climb Speed equal to the Speed of your current form. Hop. At the start of your turn, if you have noMovement remaining, you can use your Bonus Action to move up to half your Speed.

name: Charger
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Charge. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a target immediately before hitting it with a melee attack, you can attempt to shove it as part of the same action.

name: Chef
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Constitution or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Cook. You can create Cooked Meals using your Artisan's Tools. A Cooked Meal provides Temporary Hit Points. Heroic Inspiration. As part of a Short Rest, you can cook a special meal for a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Each creature that eats the meal regains 1d4 + your Proficiency Bonus Hit Points and gains Heroic Inspiration.

name: Crossbow Expert
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Crossbow Adept. You gain Proficiency with Crossbows. Neutralize Load. You can ignore the Load property of Crossbows. Fighterly. When you use the Hand Crossbow to make an attack, you can use a Bonus Action to attack with a Hand Crossbow you are holding.

name: Crusher
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Crusher's Resilience. Whenever you are hit by an attack, you can use your Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d6 + your Proficiency Bonus. Push. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a Bludgeoning damage attack, you can move it 5 feet. You can do this only if the target is a creature no more than one size larger than you.

name: Defensive Duelist
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Parry. If you are wielding a Finesse weapon in one hand and no other weapon, you can use your Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to your AC against one melee attack that would hit you. To do so, you must see the attacker and be wielding a Finesse weapon.

name: Dual Wielder
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Enhanced Dual Wielding. When you're wielding a weapon in each hand and you attack with that weapon as part of the Two-Weapon Fighting rule, you can use Two-Weapon Fighting even if the weapons aren't Light. Damage Resistance. While wielding a weapon in each hand, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

name: Durable
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Diehard. You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws. Natural Healing. When you roll a Hit Die to regain Hit Points, the minimum number of Hit Points you regain equals twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 2).

name: Elemental Adept
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Energy Adept. Choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Thunder, or Lightning. Spells you cast ignore Resistance to that damage type. Each time you cast a spell, you can change the damage type to the chosen type.

name: Fey-Touched
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Fey Magic. You learn one level 1 spell of your choice from the Bard, Cleric, or Druid spell list. You can cast this spell with this feat using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (your choice when you gain this feat).

name: Grappler
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Grappler's Techniques. You gain the following benefits: - You have Advantage on attack rolls to grapple. - Creatures you are grappling have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. - When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can grapple it as part of the same action.

name: Great Weapon Master
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Power Attack. Before making a melee attack with a Heavy weapon that you are Proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you deal an extra 10 damage. Cleave. Immediately after you score a Critical Hit or reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with a melee attack, you can make one additional melee attack as a Bonus Action.

name: Heavily Armored
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Heavy Armor Proficiency. You gain Proficiency with Heavy Armor.

name: Heavy Armor Master
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Damage Reduction. While you are wearing Heavy Armor, any Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage that you take from a non-magical attack is reduced by 3.

name: Inspiring Leader
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Rally. As a Magic action, you can bolster the morale of your allies. Choose up to six willing creatures within 30 feet of yourself. Each creature gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your level + your Charisma modifier.

name: Keen Mind
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Eidetic Memory. You can accurately recall anything you have seen or heard within the past 30 days. Direction Sense. You always know which way is north, and you can easily find your way back to a location you have visited previously.

name: Lightly Armored
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Light Armor Proficiency. You gain Proficiency with Light Armor.

name: Mage Slayer
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Mage Hunter. When a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your Reaction to make one melee weapon attack against that creature. Disruptive. When you hit a creature with an attack, that creature has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.

name: Martial Weapon Training
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Martial Weapon Proficiency. You gain Proficiency with Martial Weapons.

name: Medium Armor Master
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Medium Armor Proficiency. You gain Proficiency with Medium Armor. Improved Medium Armor. When you wear Medium Armor, you can add your full Dexterity modifier to your AC (normally, you can add only up to +2).

name: Moderately Armored
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Medium Armor and Shield Proficiency. You gain Proficiency with Medium Armor and Shields.

name: Mounted Combatant
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Mounted Advantage. While mounted, you have Advantage on attack rolls against unmounted creatures that are smaller than your mount. Defensive Rider. While mounted, you can use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on an attack roll that targets you or your mount.

name: Observant
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Keen Observer. If you can see a creature's mouth while it is speaking a language you understand, you can read its lips. Quick Search. You can take the Search action as a Bonus Action.

name: Piercer
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Piercer's Precision. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Piercing damage, you can reroll one damage die, and you must use the new roll. Armor Penetration. When you score a Critical Hit with a Piercing damage attack, you can roll one additional damage die.

name: Poisoner
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Constitution or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Poisoner's Proficiency. You gain Proficiency with the Poisoner's Kit. Poisons you create with this kit are nonmagical and deal Poison damage. Apply Poison. As a Bonus Action, you can apply a Poison to a weapon or piece of ammunition.

name: Polearm Master
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Polearm Proficiency. You gain Proficiency with the following weapons: Halberd, Pike, and Quarterstaff. Reactive Strike. While wielding a Quarterstaff, Halberd, or Pike, you can use your Reaction to make an attack with the weapon against a creature that enters your reach.

name: Resilient
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase one Ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20. Proficiency. You gain Proficiency in saving throws using the chosen Ability.

name: Ritual Caster
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Ritual Spells. You can cast a Spell as a Ritual if it is on the Bard, Cleric, or Druid spell list and has the Ritual tag. You can also cast any Spell as a Ritual if it is on your class's Spell List and has the Ritual tag.

name: Sentinel
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Sentinel's Reaction. When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with an attack, you can use your Reaction to make one melee weapon attack against that creature. If the attack hits, the creature's speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.

name: Shadow-Touched
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Shadow Magic. You learn one level 1 spell of your choice from the Bard, Cleric, or Wizard spell list that deals Cold damage or Necrotic damage. You can cast this spell with this feat using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (your choice when you gain this feat).

name: Sharpshooter
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Sharpshooter's Range. You can ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover when making ranged attacks. Powerful Shot. Before making a ranged attack with a weapon that you are Proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you deal an extra 10 damage.

name: Shield Master
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Shield Bash. If you are holding a Shield, you can use it to make a Shove attempt as a Bonus Action. Protection. You can use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on an attack roll made against a creature other than yourself that is within 5 feet of you.

name: Skill Expert
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase one Ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20. Proficiency. You gain Proficiency in one skill of your choice. Expertise. Choose one skill in which you have Proficiency. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any check you make with that skill.

name: Skulker
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Steady Aim. As a Bonus Action, you can take the Aim action. If you do, you have Advantage on your next attack roll this turn. Foursight. You can attempt to hide when you are lightly obscured from the creature from which you are hiding.

name: Slasher
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Slasher's Technique. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals Slashing damage, you can reduce that creature's Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Hamstring. When you score a Critical Hit with a Slashing damage attack, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

name: Speedy
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Fleet of Foot. Your Speed increases by 10 feet. Dash. When you take the Dash action, you can use a Bonus Action to move up to your Speed again.

name: Spell Sniper
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Spell Range. The range of your spells that require an attack roll increases by 30 feet. Double Range. When you cast a spell that has a range of 5 feet or greater, you can ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

name: Telekinetic
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Minor Telekinesis. You can use your telekinesis to move one creature within 30 feet of you. The creature must be willing or have the Incapacitated condition. You can also use your telekinesis to manipulate objects.

name: Telepathic
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Telepathic Communication. You can speak telepathically to any creature within 60 feet of you. You can't use this ability if you are Incapacitated. Telepathic Casting. You can cast spells as if you were in the space of a willing creature within 30 feet of you that can hear you.

name: War Caster
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. War Caster's Advantage. You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain Concentration on a spell. Opportunity Casting. When a creature provokes an Opportunity Attack from you, you can use your Reaction to cast a spell at the creature rather than making an Opportunity Attack.

name: Weapon Master
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Weapon Proficiency. You gain Proficiency with any four weapons of your choice.

name: Archery
description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls made with Ranged weapons.

name: Blind Fighting
description: You have Blindsight with a range of 10 feet. Within that range, you can effectively see anything that isn't behind Total Cover, even if you're Blinded or in Darkness. Moreover, you can see an Invisible creature within that range, unless the creature has managed to hide from you.

name: Blessed Warrior
description: You learn two Cleric cantrips of your choice. Your spellcasting Ability for these spells is Charisma (Paladin) or Wisdom (others).

name: Defense
description: While you are wearing Armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

name: Dueling
description: When you are wielding a Melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.

name: Great Weapon Fighting
description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are wielding with two hands, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

name: Interception
description: When a creature you can see hits a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to reduce the damage the target takes by 1d10 + your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Protection
description: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the attack roll, provided you are wielding a Shield.

name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
description: When you make a ranged attack with a Thrown weapon, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

name: Two-Weapon Fighting
description: When you engage in Two-Weapon Fighting, you can add your Ability Bonus to the damage of the second attack.

name: Unarmed Fighting
description: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal 1d6 Bludgeoning damage. If you are not holding any weapons or a Shield, your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 Bludgeoning damage, and your reach with them increases by 5 feet.

name: Druidic Warrior
description: You learn two Druid cantrips of your choice. Your spellcasting Ability for these spells is Wisdom.

name: Boon of Combat Prowess
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Combat Prowess. You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and to Armor Class.

name: Boon of Energy Resistance
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Energy Resistance. You gain Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, and Thunder damage.

name: Boon of Fate
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Divine Intervention. You can call on the forces of fate to alter reality. As a Magic action, you can roll 1d4 and apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty to one attack roll, Ability Check, or saving throw that you can see. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

name: Boon of Fortitude
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Constitution score by 2, to a maximum of 30. Fortitude. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 40.

name: Boon of Irresistible Offense
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Irresistible Offense. Your attacks deal an extra 1d10 Force damage.

name: Boon of Recovery
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Recovery. You regain all of your Hit Points when you finish a Short or Long Rest. Additionally, if you have 0 Hit Points and are making Death Saving Throws, you can use your Reaction to succeed on one of them.

name: Boon of Skill
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase any Ability score by 2, to a maximum of 30. Skill Proficiency. You gain Proficiency in all skills.

name: Boon of Speed
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Speed. Your Speed increases by 30 feet. Fly. You gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Boon of Spell Recall
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Spell Recall. You can cast any spell you know or have prepared without expending a spell slot, though you can use this benefit only once per spell per Long Rest.

name: Boon of the Night Spirit
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Night Spirit. You can cast Invisibility at will, without expending a spell slot. You can also see in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.

name: Boon of Truesight
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Truesight. You gain Truesight with a range of 120 feet.

name: Boon of Dimensional Travel
description: You gain the following benefits: Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Dimensional Travel. You can cast Misty Step at will, without expending a spell slot.
